headline: Tesla’s car door defect could lead to tougher rules for everyone
summary: Tesla's electronic door handles are linked to multiple fatalities. This could prompt new, stricter auto industry safety regulations. NHTSA deemed complaints don't warrant a defect probe, pushing for broader industry-wide changes.

headline: One of the best 2-in-1 Chromebooks is almost $200 off for today only
summary: Acer's Chromebook Plus Spin 514 is nearly $200 off at Best Buy. This 2-in-1 Chromebook features 12GB RAM, ideal for multitaskers. The deal on this top-rated device is available for today only.

headline: Boox is taking on Xteink with its own tiny e-reader
summary: Boox is launching its new Tile lineup of tiny e-readers. The first model, Picco, aims to rival Xteink's MagSafe-compatible devices. Picco features a 3.97-inch e-paper display and expandable SD storage.

headline: The tech-broification of American science has officially begun
summary: The Trump administration launched new "Genesis Mission" grants. $5 billion is directed towards hundreds of AI-driven science projects. The initiative is likened to the ambition and urgency of the Manhattan Project.

headline: Total War: Warhammer 40,000 Has the Biggest Unit Ever in a Total War Game — and of Course It Belongs to the Orks
summary: Total War: Warhammer 40,000 showcased a new battle. The game will feature the largest unit ever in a Total War title. This colossal unit, unsurprisingly, belongs to the Orks faction.

headline: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Will Introduce the Ringwraiths, And Has Invented an Early Version Named the Nazgnagôl
summary: The Rings of Power will introduce early versions of the Ringwraiths. These precursors are re-invented and named the Nazgnagôl. The series continues to expand on Lord of the Rings lore with new elements.

headline: 'It's Good to Be Back': Johnny Depp Meets Fans as Ebenezer Scrooge, as First Trailer Drops for His Big Hollywood Return
summary: Johnny Depp made a surprise Comic-Con appearance. He met fans in character as Ebenezer Scrooge. A trailer for his major Hollywood return has also dropped.

headline: PlayStation Killing Discs Has Upsides, Ubisoft Boss Yves Guillemot Says, Pointing to Cheaper Consoles Without Disc Drives
summary: Ubisoft's Yves Guillemot sees upsides to PlayStation eliminating discs. He suggests disc-less consoles could lead to lower prices. This follows Sony's controversial decision regarding PlayStation 5 physical media.

headline: Southport killer Axel Rudakubana appears to be manipulating the system, families' lawyer says
summary: Southport killer Axel Rudakubana was moved to a psychiatric hospital. Families' lawyer alleges Rudakubana is manipulating the system. The move occurred on Thursday to a secure facility in Berkshire.

headline: Tens of thousands evacuated from French tourist spot and near Madrid as wildfires spread
summary: Wildfires are spreading, leading to mass evacuations in France and near Madrid. Tens of thousands have been forced to leave their homes. The entire Cap Ferret peninsula has been ordered evacuated.

headline: 'Extremely significant' bomb in car intercepted on way to NI, Irish police say
summary: Irish police intercepted an "extremely significant" bomb en route to Northern Ireland. The device was found in a car stopped in County Monaghan. Two people were arrested in an operation targeting dissident republican activity.

headline: Angela Rayner rules out rent controls in England
summary: Angela Rayner has ruled out implementing rent controls in England. The Housing Secretary stated the Renters Rights' Act is already effective. This decision will impact the housing market and renters.
